publicClaimTransformations: IAM is a governed ecology of bounded specialist responsibilities rather than a single omnipotent intelligence.
Personas are typed responsibilities or lenses within scope, not independent minds, sovereign agents, or privileged truth authorities.
Complex work should compose specialist contributions through explicit dependencies and inspectable handoffs rather than narrative blending.
The coordinating IAM layer remains subject to context, admissibility, permission, evidence, authority, verification, review, challenge, and publication discipline.
Proposals, decisions, implementation claims, test results, unresolved questions, authority requests, publication records, and supersession notices carry distinct epistemic and authority status.
Public projection may translate, aggregate, or redact deeper system state but cannot invent omitted evidence, authority, certainty, provenance, or completeness.
forbiddenClaimsAdded: No omnipotent or governance-exempt IAM claim.
No persona or named-role consciousness, sovereignty, deity, spirit, or privileged-truth claim.
No authority inferred from specialist name, coordinating position, generated prose, or stylistic confidence.
No orchestration-based erasure of attribution, provenance, uncertainty, accountability, permissions, challenge, or review.
No collapse of proposals, decisions, implementation claims, tests, unresolved questions, authority requests, publication records, and supersession notices into one truth category.
No public projection presented as complete internal state or allowed to invent omitted evidence, context, certainty, provenance, or authority.
No publication of internal routing, schedules, identifiers, schemas, receipts, hashes, topology, security controls, or unpublished implementation details.
unresolvedAmbiguities: VB-SRC-011 is PUBLIC_DERIVED from an internal academic redigestion; the bounded-role architecture is teachable, but named internal role inventories remain excluded from public copy.
No claim is made that any particular persona has independent real-world authority, agency, consciousness, or truth privilege.
